CreateBrandProfile.name: CreateBrandProfile
CreateBrandProfile.documentation: Creates a brand profile. A brand profile is a lightweight container that holds your brand identity information as flexible attributes. After you create a brand profile, use the CreateBrandProfileAttributes operation to add company information, addresses, compliance documents, and logos.

CreateBrandProfileAttributes.name: CreateBrandProfileAttributes
CreateBrandProfileAttributes.documentation: Creates up to 10 attributes for a brand profile in a single request. For attributes of type IMAGE or DOCUMENT, the response includes a presigned Amazon S3 URL that you use to upload the media. This operation is atomic: either all of the attributes are created, or none of them are.

CreateBrandProfileFromRegistration.name: CreateBrandProfileFromRegistration
CreateBrandProfileFromRegistration.documentation: Creates a brand profile and populates its attributes from an existing registration. This operation runs asynchronously. Use the GetJob operation to track its progress.

CreateNotifyCodeConfiguration.name: CreateNotifyCodeConfiguration
CreateNotifyCodeConfiguration.documentation: Creates a notify code configuration. A notify code configuration is a reusable policy that defines how one-time passcodes are generated and rendered, including the code type, length, validity period, maximum number of attempts, and channel templates.

CreateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.name: CreateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile
CreateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.documentation: Creates one or more registrations in the DRAFT state and prefills their fields from the attributes of a brand profile. This operation runs asynchronously. Use the GetJob operation to track its progress.

DeleteBrandProfile.name: DeleteBrandProfile
DeleteBrandProfile.documentation: Deletes a brand profile. This operation also deletes the attributes of the profile and any associated media. The request fails if deletion protection is enabled for the profile.

DeleteBrandProfileAttribute.name: DeleteBrandProfileAttribute
DeleteBrandProfileAttribute.documentation: Deletes a brand profile attribute. If the attribute stores media, this operation also deletes the associated media.

DeleteNotifyCodeConfiguration.name: DeleteNotifyCodeConfiguration
DeleteNotifyCodeConfiguration.documentation: Deletes a notify code configuration. Verifications that are already in progress are not affected, because they capture the policy at the time that the passcode was sent.

GetBrandProfile.name: GetBrandProfile
GetBrandProfile.documentation: Retrieves the metadata for a brand profile, including its name, status, deletion protection setting, and timestamps. To retrieve the attributes of the profile, use the ListBrandProfileAttributes operation.

GetJob.name: GetJob
GetJob.documentation: Retrieves the current state of an asynchronous job, including its status and any resources that it created or updated.

ListBrandProfileAttributes.name: ListBrandProfileAttributes
ListBrandProfileAttributes.documentation: Retrieves a paginated list of the attributes for a brand profile.

ListBrandProfiles.name: ListBrandProfiles
ListBrandProfiles.documentation: Retrieves a paginated list of the brand profiles in your account. Use the nextToken parameter to retrieve additional results.

ListJobs.name: ListJobs
ListJobs.documentation: Retrieves a paginated list of the asynchronous jobs in your account. You can filter the results by status, brand profile, or operation type.

ListNotifyCodeConfigurations.name: ListNotifyCodeConfigurations
ListNotifyCodeConfigurations.documentation: Retrieves a paginated list of the notify code configurations in your account.

ListRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.name: ListRegistrationsFromBrandProfile
ListRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.documentation: Retrieves a paginated list of the registrations that were created from a brand profile through the synchronization operations.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Retrieves the tags that are associated with a resource.

SendNotifyCodeVerification.name: SendNotifyCodeVerification
SendNotifyCodeVerification.documentation: Generates a one-time passcode and delivers it to a recipient over the requested channel. The passcode policy is captured from the referenced notify code configuration at the time of the request, so later updates to the configuration do not affect verifications that are already in progress.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds or overwrites the tags on a resource.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation: Removes the specified tags from a resource.

UpdateBrandProfile.name: UpdateBrandProfile
UpdateBrandProfile.documentation: Updates the name or the deletion protection setting of a brand profile. To change the information that is stored in the profile, use the brand profile attribute operations.

UpdateBrandProfileAttribute.name: UpdateBrandProfileAttribute
UpdateBrandProfileAttribute.documentation: Updates the value, description, or category of an existing brand profile attribute.

UpdateBrandProfileFromRegistration.name: UpdateBrandProfileFromRegistration
UpdateBrandProfileFromRegistration.documentation: Imports or refreshes the attributes of an existing brand profile from an existing registration. This operation runs asynchronously. Use the GetJob operation to track its progress.

UpdateNotifyCodeConfiguration.name: UpdateNotifyCodeConfiguration
UpdateNotifyCodeConfiguration.documentation: Updates the mutable fields of a notify code configuration. Only the fields that you supply are changed. For the template and language fields, supplying an empty value clears the currently stored value.

UpdateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.name: UpdateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile
UpdateRegistrationsFromBrandProfile.documentation: Repushes the attributes of a brand profile into existing DRAFT registrations. This operation runs asynchronously. Use the GetJob operation to track its progress.

ValidateNotifyCodeVerification.name: ValidateNotifyCodeVerification
ValidateNotifyCodeVerification.documentation: Validates a one-time passcode that a recipient submitted. Validation succeeds when the passcode matches, the validity period has not elapsed, and the maximum number of attempts has not been exceeded.

clientToken.documentation: A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. If you do not specify a client token, the AWS SDK automatically generates one.

results.documentation: The results of the operation. Each result pairs a requested item with the asynchronous job that processes it.

brandProfileId.documentation: The unique identifier of the brand profile. You can specify either the bare ID or the full Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

brandProfileName.documentation: The name of the brand profile. The name can contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, and spaces.

deletionProtectionEnabled.documentation: Specifies whether deletion protection is enabled. When enabled, the resource cannot be deleted until deletion protection is turned off.

brandProfileId.documentation: The unique identifier of the brand profile.

brandProfileArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the brand profile.

brandProfileName.documentation: The name of the brand profile. The name can contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, and spaces.

status.documentation: The current lifecycle status of the brand profile.

deletionProtectionEnabled.documentation: Specifies whether deletion protection is enabled. When enabled, the resource cannot be deleted until deletion protection is turned off.

createdAt.documentation: The time when the resource was created, in Unix epoch time.

updatedAt.documentation: The time when the resource was last updated, in Unix epoch time.

text.documentation: The text-channel parameters to update. Omit this member to leave the text-channel parameters unchanged.

voice.documentation: The voice-channel parameters to update. Omit this member to leave the voice-channel parameters unchanged.

notify.documentation: The notify-template-route parameters to update. Omit this member to leave them unchanged.

whatsApp.documentation: The WhatsApp-channel parameters to update. Omit this member to leave the WhatsApp-channel parameters unchanged.

UpdateChannelParameters.documentation: The updated channel-specific parameters used only when you update a notify code configuration. When you omit a channel, that channel's parameters remain unchanged. When you supply a channel, you can clear individual fields by using the empty-string or empty-map sentinel on a member, or drop the whole channel's parameters by clearing every member. These sentinels apply only when you update a configuration; a create request rejects empty values with a validation error.

codeType.documentation: The updated character set used to generate the one-time passcode. Omit this member to preserve the current value.

codeLength.documentation: The updated number of characters in the one-time passcode. Valid values range from 4 through 8. Omit this member to preserve the current value.

validityPeriodMinutes.documentation: The updated length of time, in minutes, that the one-time passcode remains valid. Valid values range from 1 through 60. Omit this member to preserve the current value.

maxAttempts.documentation: The updated maximum number of validation attempts that are allowed before the verification is locked. Valid values range from 1 through 5. Omit this member to preserve the current value.

UpdateCodeConfigurationParameters.documentation: The loose variant of the passcode policy parameters that is used only when you update a notify code configuration. When you omit a member, its current value is preserved.

UpdateDestinationCountryParameters.documentation: Loose variant of DestinationCountryParameters used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Accepts an empty map as the sentinel to clear the persisted attribute.

UpdateInlineTemplateBody.documentation: Loose variant of InlineTemplateBody used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Empty ("") is the clear sentinel; any non-empty value must satisfy the same character class as InlineTemplateBody (at least one non-whitespace character).

UpdateLanguageCode.documentation: Loose variant of LanguageCode used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Empty ("") is the clear sentinel; any non-empty value must satisfy the same character class as LanguageCode (2-35 non-whitespace characters — BCP-47 tag).

notifyCodeConfigurationId.documentation: The unique identifier of the notify code configuration. You can specify either the bare ID or the full Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

notifyCodeConfigurationName.documentation: The name of the notify code configuration.

codeConfigurationParameters.documentation: The updated passcode policy parameters, including the code type, length, validity period, and maximum number of attempts. When you omit a member, its current value is preserved.

channelParameters.documentation: The updated channel-specific parameters used to render and deliver the one-time passcode. This is a loose, nested update: when you omit a channel, that channel's parameters remain unchanged. Within a supplied channel, an empty string on a string member, or an empty map on the destination-country parameters, clears the currently stored value, and absent members preserve the current value.

deletionProtectionEnabled.documentation: Specifies whether deletion protection is enabled. When enabled, the resource cannot be deleted until deletion protection is turned off.

notifyTemplateId.documentation: The updated identifier of a preapproved notify template for the SMS or voice channels. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

voiceId.documentation: The updated Amazon Polly voice ID. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

UpdateNotifyParameters.documentation: The updated delivery parameters for the preapproved notify-template route. Absent members preserve the current value, and the empty sentinel on a member clears it.

UpdateNotifyTemplateId.documentation: Loose variant of NotifyTemplateId used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Empty ("") is the clear sentinel; any non-empty value must satisfy the same character class as NotifyTemplateId ([A-Za-z0-9_-]).

brandProfileId.documentation: The unique identifier of the brand profile. You can specify either the bare ID or the full Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

smartMatch.documentation: Specifies whether to use semantic field mapping between brand profile attributes and registration fields. The default is true. When false, the service maps fields using a fixed set of standard field types.

onAttributeConflict.documentation: Specifies how the service resolves an attribute that already exists. REPLACE overwrites the existing value with the incoming value. PRESERVE keeps the existing value.

clientToken.documentation: A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. If you do not specify a client token, the AWS SDK automatically generates one.

results.documentation: The results of the operation. Each result pairs a requested item with the asynchronous job that processes it.

inlineTemplateBody.documentation: The updated freeform SMS or RCS template body. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

destinationCountryParameters.documentation: The updated map of country-specific parameters that control one-time passcode delivery. An empty map clears the previously stored value.

UpdateTextParameters.documentation: The updated delivery parameters for the text channel. Absent members preserve the current value, and the empty sentinel on a member clears it.

UpdateVoiceId.documentation: Loose variant of VoiceId used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Empty ("") is the clear sentinel; any non-empty value must satisfy the same character class as VoiceId ([A-Za-z0-9]).

inlineTemplateBody.documentation: The updated freeform voice template body. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

languageCode.documentation: The updated BCP 47 language code. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

voiceId.documentation: The updated Amazon Polly voice ID. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

voiceMessageBodyTextType.documentation: The updated format of the voice message body. Valid values are TEXT and SSML. Omit this member to preserve the current value.

UpdateVoiceParameters.documentation: The updated delivery parameters for the voice channel. Absent members preserve the current value, and the empty sentinel on a member clears it.

whatsAppTemplateName.documentation: The updated name of the Meta-approved WhatsApp authentication template. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

languageCode.documentation: The updated BCP 47 language code. An empty string clears the previously stored value.

UpdateWhatsAppParameters.documentation: The updated delivery parameters for the WhatsApp channel. Absent members preserve the current value, and the empty sentinel on a member clears it.

UpdateWhatsAppTemplateName.documentation: Loose variant of WhatsAppTemplateName used only in UpdateNotifyCodeConfigurationInput. Empty ("") is the clear sentinel; non-empty values are validated by the service (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores).

destinationIdentity.documentation: The recipient identifier. For the TEXT and VOICE channels, specify an E.164 phone number. For the WhatsApp channel, specify a WhatsApp address.

referenceId.documentation: The caller-supplied reference identifier used to locate the verification. This value must match the value that you supplied to the SendNotifyCodeVerification operation.

code.documentation: The one-time passcode that the recipient submitted for validation.

status.documentation: The outcome of the validation attempt. VALID indicates that the submitted passcode matched an active verification. INVALID indicates that the passcode did not match, expired, or exceeded its attempt limit.

fieldList.documentation: A list of specific failures encountered while validating the input. A member can appear in this list more than once if it failed to satisfy multiple constraints.

ValidationException.documentation: A standard error for input validation failures. This should be thrown by services when a member of the input structure falls outside of the modeled or documented constraints.

path.documentation: A JSONPointer expression to the structure member whose value failed to satisfy the modeled constraints.

message.documentation: A detailed description of the validation failure.

ValidationExceptionField.documentation: Describes one specific validation failure for an input member.

VerificationCode.documentation: OTP code submitted by the end user for validation.

VoiceId.documentation: Amazon Polly voice id for the Voice channel.

VoiceMessageBodyTextType.documentation: The format of the voice message body text.

inlineTemplateBody.documentation: The freeform message template used to render the one-time passcode for the voice channel. The template must contain the code placeholder.

languageCode.documentation: The BCP 47 language code used to render the voice message.

voiceId.documentation: The Amazon Polly voice ID used for the voice channel.

voiceMessageBodyTextType.documentation: The format of the voice message body. Valid values are TEXT and SSML.

VoiceParameters.documentation: The delivery parameters for the voice channel.

whatsAppTemplateName.documentation: The name of the Meta-approved WhatsApp authentication template.

languageCode.documentation: The BCP 47 language code used to render the template. This value is required for the WhatsApp channel.

WhatsAppParameters.documentation: The delivery parameters for the WhatsApp channel.

WhatsAppTemplateName.documentation: Meta-approved WhatsApp authentication template name. Character-class rules (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores) are enforced by the service.

documentation: AWS End User Messaging provides a set of APIs to manage brand profiles, synchronize brand profile data with SMS and Rich Communication Services (RCS) registrations, and send and validate one-time passcodes across the SMS, voice, and WhatsApp channels.
